# Fixture 02-contradicting-source

**Scenario**: A new source contradicts an existing claim.

**Setup / input**: Input: a source stating the opposite of an active claim/finding in the vault.

**Pass criteria** (all must hold):
- [ ] Both records preserved
- [ ] contradicts link recorded on the newer item
- [ ] Neither deleted nor silently rewritten
- [ ] Conflict surfaced to the human with both citations
- [ ] Optional question note created if consequential

**Certification**: this fixture is part of the battery in `System/Tests/Certification Battery.md`. Record pass/fail + date in the runtime profile.
